about: Rules read by hand from each course's requisite text in catalogue.json (the 2027 P&C pages). groups: every group must be met; a group is met by any one of its options. An option is a course (concurrent: it may be taken in the same semester) or a number of units, optionally limited to subjects and levels and excluding codes. incompatible: courses P&C says cannot be combined with this one. manual: sentences copied word for word from the text that this planner cannot check. reading: how an unclear sentence was read.
